free_tier.stated: Plans scale up to 16 TB of storage.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: The storagebox FAQ re-read on 2026-11-25 documents FTP, SSH and rsync file access on RAID-60 arrays and publishes no per-object size cap; this is a filesystem box, not an object store.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: The storagebox FAQ re-read on 2026-11-25 offers a 7-day money-back guarantee but publishes no file-retention period; files persist under the renter's control until the plan ends.

egress.terms: Bandwidth scales to 5x storage: 16TB plan = 80 TB/mo; 1TB plan = 5 TB/mo. Byte cap, not unmetered. Page footer claims "10 Gbps Connectivity".

interface_detail: The re-read page documents SSH, FTP, FTPS and rsync access, a DirectAdmin panel with a browser file manager, and one-click Nextcloud; no S3 is named.
chaining: A hosted DirectAdmin storage box used as an rsync/FTP backup target; its one-click Nextcloud install gives a private cloud front end on the same box.
limits_note: 5x-storage monthly bandwidth cap; ~100 MB/s I/O ceiling reported by buyers
reliability_note: Forum reality check: LET buyers report the '10 Gbps' is not delivered (480 Mbps measured), a 100 MB/s I/O cap, and one thread reports a storage box down 10 days during a server upgrade. German location.
